title.narrative: Electrification of Industry and Facilitating larger role for BEE in Energy Transition

description.narrative: In India, only about 25% of total end-use energy consumed is attributed to electricity. Energy intensive sectors like industry, commercial, transport etc. do use fossil fuel based energy (Coal, fuel oil, Gas etc) in the processes or operations. Non-electric based energy usage is typically inefficient. As an energy transition effort, India has launched "Go-Electric" campaign to improve process efficiency and per-capita electricity consumption by using more electricity in all economic sectors. India has the ambitious plans to meet the further electricity demand from green sources like renewables, BioCNG, waste heat, green hydrogen etc. The NDC goals and de-carbonization plans of the country see the transition to electricity as one of the action plans. However, there is a need to establish a deep-drive study to establish the potential and opportunities of electricity transition in key sectors like industry, commercial, retail and transport to know (a) Identify and detail out key technologies that would support the switch to electrification (b) Identify specific deployment opportunities (c) Investment requirement (d) Cost-benefit analysis (e) Identify challenges, and potential solutions, to deployment (f) Develop a roadmap for electrification to 2030 and beyond. This techno-policy study will be a policy paper for Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power, Govt. of India who is custodian of ensuring NDC goals and Net-Zero plans. This study report would also be useful for NITI Aayog, MNRE and MoP&NG to define the technology and investment pathway for transition to electricity. The finding of the study may also set the background for getting support from GEF or GCF or CTF for a scaled-up national program.

The objective of this project is to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the potential for electrification in the industrial, commercial, retail , and transport sectors in India, identify the key sectors and applications where electrification can have the most significant impact, and prepare a roadmap for electrification that outlines the policy measures, investment, and technologies required to enable the transition towards a sustainable and clean energy future.
